# JustClub

> JustClub is an all-in-one cloud POS, live table timer, split billing, café inventory, and customer khata ledger operating platform for snooker, billiards, and multi-game entertainment lounges in India.

## Core Platform & Commercial Solutions

- [JustClub Home](https://justclub.in/): Multi-game club operating platform dashboard with live timers, 10 game category rate cards, customer khata CRM, and 15-day free trial.
- [Club Management Software](https://justclub.in/club-management-software/): Cloud club management system with multi-station timers, split billing, canteen POS, and dynamic UPI QR checkout.
- [Snooker Club Management Software](https://justclub.in/snooker-club-management-software/): Tournament snooker table timers, exact-minute or block billing, 1v1 loser-pays split, and WhatsApp UPI receipts.
- [Billiards Club Management Software](https://justclub.in/billiards-club-management-software/): English billiards session timers, member discount cards, and khata credit accounting.
- [Pool Club Management Software](https://justclub.in/pool-club-management-software/): High-turnover 8-ball and 9-ball table billing, group split payments, and snack POS.
- [Gaming Club Management Software](https://justclub.in/gaming-club-management-software/): PS5 booths, PC gaming stations, VR pods, and console lounge timers.
- [Snooker Table Timer Software](https://justclub.in/snooker-table-timer/): Hardware-free cloud timers with real-time sync, pause/resume, and table-transfer capabilities.
- [Club POS Software](https://justclub.in/club-pos-software/): Combined table tariff and canteen snack POS with real-time inventory decrements.
- [Club Membership Software](https://justclub.in/club-membership-software/): VIP member discount cards, advance wallet balances, and customer CRM.

## India Commercial Hub & City Lounges

- [Snooker Software India Hub](https://justclub.in/snooker-software-india/): Purpose-built snooker parlor software for India with native UPI QR, WhatsApp invoicing, and INR pricing.
- [Bangalore Snooker POS](https://justclub.in/locations/india/bangalore/): Snooker and pool parlor software for Koramangala, Indiranagar, HSR Layout, and Whitefield.
- [Chennai Snooker POS](https://justclub.in/locations/india/chennai/): Cue sports club software for T Nagar, Anna Nagar, Adyar, and OMR.
- [Coimbatore Snooker POS](https://justclub.in/locations/india/coimbatore/): Snooker club software for Peelamedu, Gandhipuram, and RS Puram.
- [Hyderabad Snooker POS](https://justclub.in/locations/india/hyderabad/): Luxury cue-sports lounge software for Madhapur, Gachibowli, and Jubilee Hills.
- [Mumbai Snooker POS](https://justclub.in/locations/india/mumbai/): High-turnover parlor software for Bandra, Andheri, Powai, and Navi Mumbai.
- [Delhi NCR Snooker POS](https://justclub.in/locations/india/delhi/): Club software for South Delhi, Gurgaon, and Noida.
- [Pune Snooker POS](https://justclub.in/locations/india/pune/): Student and IT corridor snooker software for Koregaon Park, Baner, and Hinjawadi.
- [Kolkata Snooker POS](https://justclub.in/locations/india/kolkata/): Billiards and snooker club software for Park Street and Salt Lake.

## Interactive Business Calculators

- [Snooker Club Profit Calculator](https://justclub.in/tools/snooker-club-profit-calculator/): Free interactive calculator to model monthly revenues, expenses, canteen margins, and net ROI.
- [Snooker Table Revenue Calculator](https://justclub.in/tools/snooker-table-revenue-calculator/): Single table and multi-table annual yield estimator.
- [Snooker Club Break-Even Calculator](https://justclub.in/tools/snooker-club-break-even-calculator/): Daily occupancy and minimum hours required to cover fixed overheads.

## Product Features & Invoicing

- [Table Billing Engine](https://justclub.in/features/table-billing/): Exact-minute pro-rata and 15-minute block billing calculations.
- [Live Table Timers](https://justclub.in/features/live-table-timer/): Digital multi-station session tracking with zero electrical hardware.
- [Dynamic UPI Payments](https://justclub.in/features/upi-payments/): Instant on-screen UPI QR codes for GPay, PhonePe, Paytm, and BHIM.
- [WhatsApp Invoicing](https://justclub.in/features/whatsapp/): 1-click digital receipt dispatch and customer debt reminders.
- [Customer Khata Ledger](https://justclub.in/features/ledger/): Digital credit tracking, advance balances, and payment statements.
- [Canteen Inventory POS](https://justclub.in/features/canteen-billing/): Real-time snack decrements and attached table tabs.
- [Staff Management & Shift Audits](https://justclub.in/features/staff-management/): Role permissions and anti-pilferage cash reconciliations.
